DMS_OfficerTrainingLetters.rulePack.rule.li: arrivedLetterText->The orbital transport requisitioned by [askerName] has landed. [traineeName] must board it for the [courseName] at the [issuerFactionName] training centre.

graduateLetterText->[traineeName] has completed the [courseName] and is being returned by drop pod, promoted from [oldTitle] to [newTitle] by order of [issuerFactionName].\n\nThe course record notes a marked improvement in [skillName].

graduateNoTraitLetterText->[traineeName] has completed the [courseName] and is being returned by drop pod, promoted from [oldTitle] to [newTitle] by order of [issuerFactionName].\n\nThe instructors found nothing in [traineeName]'s discipline worth correcting, so they spent the time on the syllabus instead. The [skillName] instruction on record runs well past the standard for the grade.

capturedLetterText->[issuerFactionName] went to war with [playerFactionName] while [traineeName] was still at the training establishment. The service education command has handed [traineeName] over to the provost.\n\n[traineeName] is not coming back on a transport. Getting [traineeName] out is our problem now.
abortLetterText->Hostilities with [issuerFactionName] have voided the course allocation for [traineeName]. The transport has been recalled.

missedLetterText->The transport requisitioned by [askerName] has departed. [issuerFactionName] has struck [traineeName] from the roll for this run of the officer training course; the promotion will have to wait for another opportunity.
